scope: Proposition 3.3 (Persistence and area comparison for sign tests) of the manuscript “Smooth counterexamples to Yau's nodal upper bound in dimensions three and four” (preprints/Smooth-counterexamples-to-Yaus-nodal-upper-bound-in-dimensions-three-and-four-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 350 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8e4c129bdb0f2f45), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 17. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The functional Fn is lower semicontinuous for uniform convergence of real functions. It is unchanged by multiplication by a nonzero real constant or by an everywhere positive continuous function. There is a constant Carea, depending only on the fixed coordinates and metric neighborhood, such that for every continuous real f and every h ∈ G, Fn(f) ≤ CareaH2 h({f = 0}). (3.15) In particular Carea is independent of ϕ, P, and n. There is also a constant Csign with the same independence such that 0 ≤ Fn(f) ≤ Csignn Z Ω L(x) dx. (3.16)
